subject.title: feat(memory): default cross-conversation recall for personal installs

question: Should automatic private recall be enabled only after every channel's effective runtime DM scope proves a personal install, including channels such as Zalouser that assign isolation at route time?
rationale: The PR changes an established privacy default, but the current config-only predicate cannot represent all channel runtime scope contracts; choosing the permanent default and API boundary requires feature-owner intent.

options.title: Require a runtime-scope-aware gate
options.body: Pass effective DM scope into recall eligibility and leave automatic recall off whenever runtime isolation is non-main or unknown.

options.title: Limit the initial rollout
options.body: Keep the global default-off contract and allow default-on only through an explicit owner-selected setting until channel runtime scopes have a shared contract.

options.title: Accept the config-only inference
options.body: Merge the current behavior while accepting that some dynamically isolated channel DMs may receive same-agent cross-sender recall.

recommendation.title: Require a runtime-scope-aware gate
recommendation.body: Pass effective DM scope into recall eligibility and leave automatic recall off whenever runtime isolation is non-main or unknown.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged baseline feature and canonical product request that set the original default-off privacy contract.
